title: KU college of engineering and Technology singed

pages.content:
KU college of engineering and Technology singed
MOU with United Way of Hyderabad for up skilling
students in Data science.
In a significant move aimed at enhancing the employability of its students,
Kakatiya University College of Engineering and Technology (KUCET),Kakatiya
University Warangal, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) today
with United Way of Hyderabad. The collaboration is designed to provide
focused training to 250 students in soft skills and data science, equipping them
with industry-relevant competencies to boost their placement readiness.
The MoU signing was held in the presence of Prof. K.Pratap Reddy, Vice-
Chancellor of Kakatiya University, Prof. V. Ramachandram, Registrar, and Dr. N.
Ramana, Principal of KUCET.
Dr V Mahendar, and Mr. Santhosh Kumar, TPO also participated in the
program. From
United Way of Hyderabad Mr. Bharath Merugu, Manager, and Ms. Soumya
Maireddy, Senior Associate attended.
